d: During the trilateral talks with Russian President Putin and Chinese President Xi, US President Donald Trump said, 'The United States, Russia, and China are uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth, and also to lessen the risk that those weapons will ever be used. The power is unbelievable, unthinkable. In addition to exploring the potential for arms reduction in our own countries, I must say, it's quite frankly a very hard thing to do because once you have the nuclear weapons, it's very hard to not have them.
